Checkpoint

A restorable point, rendered as a divider through the transcript. Restoring TRUNCATES the conversation, so it confirms first — the web puts it behind a hover tooltip, which does not exist on touch.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/checkpoint.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/checkpoint.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/icon.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/icon.json
